panels.title: Online
panels.description: Connected to wg-fleet and answering scrapes

panels.title: No scrapes
panels.description: Connected to wg-fleet, but Prometheus can't scrape them

panels.title: On battery
panels.description: Laptops discharging right now, most likely unplugged. Several at one site can mean a power problem

panels.title: Battery critical
panels.description: Laptops discharging with 15% or less left, or whose battery reports Critical. Plugged-in laptops aren't counted, even when low

targets.expr: count((((max by (fleet,site,hostname,instance)(node_power_supply_capacity{job="node_exporter",fleet=~"$fleet",site=~"$site",power_supply!~"hid.*|hidpp.*|wacom.*|ucsi.*"}) <= 15) or (max by (fleet,site,hostname,instance)(node_power_supply_info{job="node_exporter",fleet=~"$fleet",site=~"$site",type="Battery",power_supply!~"hid.*|hidpp.*|wacom.*|ucsi.*",capacity_level="Critical"}) * 0)) and on(instance) max by (fleet,site,hostname,instance)(node_power_supply_info{job="node_exporter",fleet=~"$fleet",site=~"$site",type="Battery",power_supply!~"hid.*|hidpp.*|wacom.*|ucsi.*",status="Discharging"}))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Dropped off
panels.description: Seen in the last 2 hours and not connected now, not counting the generic fleet

targets.expr: count(max by (fleet,site,hostname)(max by (fleet,site,hostname,instance)(max_over_time(timestamp(up{job="node_exporter",fleet=~"$fleet",site=~"$site",fleet!="generic"})[2h:1m])) unless on(instance) up{job="node_exporter",fleet=~"$fleet",site=~"$site"} unless on(fleet,hostname) up{job="node_exporter",fleet=~"$fleet",site=~"$site"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Rebooted (30 min)
panels.description: Booted in the last 30 minutes

panels.title: Up over $uptime_limit
panels.description: Machines that haven't rebooted within the limit chosen above

panels.title: Backups over $backup_limit
panels.description: Connected machines whose last backup is older than the limit chosen above, or that have none yet

targets.expr: count(((max by (fleet,site,hostname,instance)((time() - label_replace(last_over_time(icpc_backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds{fleet!="generic"}[6h]),"hostname","$1","host","(.*)")) * on(fleet,hostname) group_left(site,instance) clamp_min(up{job="node_exporter",fleet=~"$fleet",site=~"$site"},1)) > $backup_limit) or (max by (fleet,site,hostname,instance)(up{job="node_exporter",fleet=~"$fleet",site=~"$site",fleet!="generic"} unless on(fleet,hostname) label_replace(last_over_time(icpc_backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds{fleet!="generic"}[6h]),"hostname","$1","host","(.*)")) * 0 - 1))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Printouts
panels.description: Since each machine's last team reset, including machines switched off in the last 6 hours. Updates every minute

panels.title: Print queue
panels.description: Jobs waiting in CUPS. A number that doesn't go down means a stuck printer. Updates every minute

panels.title: Behind on ansible
panels.description: Connected machines that haven't applied the latest revision in their fleet's repo, or aren't reporting one. They pick it up at their next boot or with just contest trigger-ansible

targets.expr: count((up{job="node_exporter",fleet=~"$fleet",site=~"$site"} == 1 unless on(instance) (icpc_version_info{job="node_exporter",fleet=~"$fleet",site=~"$site"} and on(fleet,applied) label_replace(icpc_fleet_head_info,"applied","$1","revision","(.*)")))) or vector(0)
